ache.title: A Caterpie that refuses to evolve? I love him
ache.note: This is the sweet one: a Caterpie that won’t evolve, using ‘Find a Friend’ to gather Grass Pokémon, with Venusaur EX to finish. Nero shows a low rarity deck holding its own, and that’s the lesson: you don’t need the rare chase cards. It still leans on one EX, so don’t let that one card become a pack-ripping spree.
watch: the one EX it still relies on
meta talk pulling you to rarer decks
ache.tip: Love the low rarity deck. When the meta calls for rarer cards, stay with the Caterpie.

videoData.title: Catersaur EX: the Tiniest Meta Contender | Pokémon TCG Pocket

textData.text: In this episode, I share the remarkable story of a unique Pokémon deck centered around a Caterpie that refuses to evolve, opting instead to live happily with its friends. This 'Catersaur' deck features strategic use of Caterpie's 'Find a Friend' attack to gather Grass Pokémon and relies on Venusaur EX for victory. Witness how this low rarity deck demonstrates incredible performance in battles, surviving tough opponents with healing and strategic moves. Join me, Nero Atlas, as we dive into the intricacies of the Catersaur deck and its gameplay.
